_comment: Optional version pins. Kiln reads this file from the URL in K.DefaultManifestUrl (src/Core/Util.cs) or the manifestUrl setting in kiln.json. Any component listed here with a url is downloaded from that url (and checked against sha256 when given) instead of being looked up live. Remove an entry to go back to automatic lookup. Keys: apache, php-<branch>, mariadb, phpmyadmin, node, node-<major>.
